newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index ends touch higher.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index ends touch higher.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was up 1.2 points or 1.7 percent at 73.34 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index ended 49.4 points or 1.5 percent higher at a provisional 3,404.1.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 13.12 percent after 12.93 percent on Wednesday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
